name: Folloze
description:
Create personalized account experiences with Claude, then let Folloze deploy, host, and capture the engagement signal.
Folloze is the open execution platform for B2B marketing. The MCP server connects Claude to your workspace so you can build, update, and track personalized microsites, campaign experiences, and account journeys using natural language.

What you can do:
•Build personalized microsites and account experiences
•Turn a PDF or white paper into an interactive buyer experience
•Track account and contact engagement signals
•Automate common campaign workflows

Authentication uses OAuth. Every operation respects the permissions of the authenticated Folloze user.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Folloze to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Folloze to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.folloze.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Folloze MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Folloze provides these MCP tools: get_company_theme, get_folloze_board_creation_guide, save_folloze_board_from_html, and whoami.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Folloze?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Folloze in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Folloze requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Folloze is developed by Folloze. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
